youtube.title: Charles Darwin's savage marriage pros and cons list 🐶 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Charles Darwin decided whether to get married with an actual pros and cons list. 📝🐶

Pro: "better than a dog anyhow." Con: less time for books. Then Emma read it.

Would you say yes to this proposal? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Darwin's real 1838 notes "Marry / Not Marry" ("Constant companion… better than a dog anyhow", ending "Marry—Marry—Marry Q.E.D."). He married Emma Wedgwood in 1839.

#charlesdarwin #darwin #evolution #originofspecies #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
